title: Tin thay đổi rất ngắn
content_html:
Reactivity Transform {#reactivity-transform}

:::danger Removed Experimental Feature Reactivity Transform was an experimental feature, and has been removed in the latest 3.4 release. Please read about the reasoning here.

If you still intend to use it, it is now available via the Vue Macros plugin. :::

:::tip Composition-API-specific Reactivity Transform is a Composition-API-specific feature and requires a build step. :::
